scenes.vo: [playful, conspiratorial] POV: you're an agency owner, finding out why your leads went cold. For context: in one US study, forty-eight percent of buyer inquiries never got a reply from an agent.
scenes.label: no reply from an agent (US study, 2013–14)

scenes.vo: The shared inbox. The unread badge no longer shows a number. It just says "yes".
Next, the website form. It's been emailing someone who left. Last spring.
[delighted] Then the portal leads. Forwarded, every one, to a WhatsApp group called "Leads FINAL final".
Nobody's lazy. In this office, every lead just went somewhere nobody was looking.
[playful] The fix: one place every enquiry lands, an instant first reply, and a person who follows up fast.
